decisive_items: a large, heterogeneously attenuating right renal mass
a heterogeneously enhancing expansile mass in the upper pole of the right kidney
tumoral extension into the right renal vein and inferior vena cava
response.rationale: The imaging findings of a large heterogeneous enhancing renal mass with venous invasion and pulmonary nodules strongly indicate renal cell carcinoma. Clear cell subtype is plausible but not histologically confirmed, so the broader diagnosis is preferred.

rejected.why: Nephroblastoma is highly atypical in a 27-year-old adult.
Angiomyolipoma would typically show macroscopic fat and does not explain vascular invasion and pulmonary nodules.
Imaging explicitly reports no nephrolithiasis, and the renal mass explains the hematuria and pain.
